{{Quote|This place reminds me of you, Ulic. Isolated… frozen… crumbling.|[[Nomi Sunrider]] regarding [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]]|<ref name="Redemption 5">[[Tales of the Jedi – Redemption 5|''Tales of the Jedi – Redemption'' 5]]</ref>}}
'''Rhen Var''' was a planet situated near the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and one of the former [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium Worlds]]. It was the first planet in the [[Tobali system]]. Throughout the history of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Rhen Var was covered in ice, rendering it almost uninhabitable. Remains of an ancient civilization and old [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Light side artifact|artifacts]] were found beneath the ice on the planet, remnants of a former civilization.

==Description==
[[File:Rhen_var_3986BBY.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Surface of Rhen Var in 3986 BBY.]]
Rhen Var was once a fertile paradise filled with vegetation and wildlife. Thousands of years before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] cataclysm turned it into an icy hibernal surface. Since then, it had been a frigid world of frozen tundra and snow swept mountains.<ref name="BFI guide" />

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Thanium system/Legends|Thanium system]], [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Tor (star)|Tor]], had a [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of 18 [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] and the year was 563 standard days. The planet was at [[Galactic coordinates/Legends|galactic coordinates]] R-6.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
During the time of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Rakatan Infinite Empire]], the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] ruled Rhen Var.<ref name="TEA" />

In those millennia a civilization flourished, building castles, fortresses and temples; eventually it went extinct due to the advance of a planetary ice age that, by the [[Post-Manderon period]], took over, and snow engulfed the ruins of their creations.<ref name="Redemption" />

A decade after the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] in [[3986 BBY]], former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] sought refuge on Rhen Var, and there [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] [[Vima Sunrider]]. He ultimately found peace in the snowy wastes, and was redeemed and then was later murdered by [[Hoggon]].<ref name="Redemption">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Redemption]]''</ref>

Later, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Satele Shan]] and a large Republic army [[Battle of Rhen Var|battled]] [[Darth Mekhis]] and a force of Sith during the last [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="Lost Suns1" />

Prior to the Clone Wars, the Republic set up a small supply base and listening post on Rhen Var. At the start of the Clone Wars in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] seized Rhen Var with an army so large that the Republic [[Bravo Base|base]] had to evacuate the planet. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] informed the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] about the seizure of the planet. The Separatists' motives in taking the world were unclear until Kenobi and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] discovered [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] uncovering the [[Force Harvester]] on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]]. The answers to its power would be located in the [[Jedi monument (Rhen Var)|tomb]] of Ulic Qel-Droma on Rhen Var. After the liberation of [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]],<ref name="SW:CW game" /> the Republic retook Rhen Var in the [[Battle of Rhen Var (Clone Wars)|Battle of Rhen Var]].<ref name="BFI" /> During the battle, Anakin learned from Qel-Droma's [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] how to defeat the Force Harvester which would power the [[Dark Reaper]] located on the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] world of [[Thule/Legends|Thule]].<ref name="SW:CW game" />

[[File:Rhen_Var_Citadel.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ancient citadel on Rhen Var during the Galactic Civil War.]]
Later, around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] troops [[Attack on Rhen Var|attacked]] and secured an Imperial listening post. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] soon struck back and [[Sabotage at Rhen Var|eliminated]] the Alliance.<ref name="BFI" />

The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] captured the world during their invasion of the Outer Rim.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
When [[Ralph McQuarrie]] created conceptual art for the Ice Planet which became [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], he included illustrations of ruins emerging from the snow. While this did not become a part of the film, the concepts of the ruins of a lost civilization choked in snow and ice may have influenced the development of Rhen Var. Images reflecting this were reprinted in ''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''.
